name: hoistable
description: Self-hoisting software as skills, agent-first. Two verbs: hoistable makes an app into a distributable hoist skill; hoist runs a distributable into a running, graded environment.

plugins.name: hoistable
plugins.description: The builder verb — /hoistable. Make your app into a self-building distributable hoist skill: self-extract the toolchain, then emit <app>.hoist.SKILL.md, graded over the whole stack. What someone later hoists.

plugins.name: hoist
plugins.description: The deploy verb — /hoist. Run a distributable (a config, or an <app>.hoist.SKILL.md) into a running, graded environment on your target. Self-extracts the enforced harness; deploys non-destructively and grades honestly.
